package com.example.coldrun.content

import android.util.Log
import com.pico.spatial.core.ecs.DirectionalLightComponent
import com.pico.spatial.core.ecs.Entity
import com.pico.spatial.core.ecs.EnvironmentLightingSettingsComponent
import com.pico.spatial.core.ecs.GroundShadowComponent
import com.pico.spatial.core.ecs.TransformComponent
import com.pico.spatial.core.ecs.light.ShadowProjectionType
import com.pico.spatial.core.math.Color4
import com.pico.spatial.core.math.EulerAngles
import com.pico.spatial.core.math.Quat
import com.pico.spatial.core.math.Vector3

/**
 * Generated by generate_lighting_kotlin — an AAA rig: a shadow-casting sun + a cool fill + IBL.
 * Call SceneLighting.apply(content) after the scene root exists; call SceneLighting.groundShadow(e)
 * on each solid 3D prop so it casts a contact shadow, and SceneLighting.shadowReceiver(floor) on the
 * ground plane. VERIFIED on the emulator: soft directional shadows + PBR metallic specular render.
 * NOTE: the emulator's IBL environment is dim, so this rig supplies its own direct light (bright by
 * design) — a scene that relies on IBL alone renders dark.
 */
object SceneLighting {
    private const val TAG = "SceneLighting"
    private const val SUN_LUX = 3500f
    private const val FILL_LUX = 1800f
    private const val IBL_SCALE = 2.5f

    fun apply(content: Entity) {
        runCatching {
            if (IBL_SCALE > 0f) content.components.set(EnvironmentLightingSettingsComponent(IBL_SCALE))
            val sun = Entity()
            sun.setName("SceneSun")
            sun.components.set(
                TransformComponent(Vector3(0f, 4f, 0f), Quat.identity(), Vector3(1f, 1f, 1f))
                    .setEulerAngles(EulerAngles(55f, -28f, 0f))
            )
            val sunLight = DirectionalLightComponent(Color4(1f, 0.96f, 0.87f, 1f), SUN_LUX)
            sunLight.castsShadowEnabled = true
            sunLight.shadowProjectionType = ShadowProjectionType.Auto(8f)
            sun.components.set(sunLight)
            content.addChild(sun)
            if (FILL_LUX > 0f) {
                val fill = Entity()
                fill.setName("SceneFill")
                fill.components.set(
                    TransformComponent(Vector3(0f, 3f, 0f), Quat.identity(), Vector3(1f, 1f, 1f))
                        .setEulerAngles(EulerAngles(35f, 150f, 0f))
                )
                fill.components.set(DirectionalLightComponent(Color4(0.7f, 0.8f, 1f, 1f), FILL_LUX))
                content.addChild(fill)
            }
            Log.i(TAG, "AAA lighting applied (sun=${SUN_LUX}lux shadows=true, fill=${FILL_LUX}, ibl=${IBL_SCALE})")
        }.onFailure { Log.e(TAG, "lighting failed: ${it.message}") }
    }

    /** Make a solid 3D prop cast a soft contact/ground shadow. Call per prop entity. */
    fun groundShadow(e: Entity) { runCatching { e.components.set(GroundShadowComponent(true, false)) } }

    /** Make a floor/ground plane RECEIVE ground shadows. Call on the ground entity. */
    fun shadowReceiver(e: Entity) { runCatching { e.components.set(GroundShadowComponent(false, true)) } }
}
